details:
Q1: Three settings in the issue's "full set" are passed by no workflow today: `MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLD_MINUTES` (README.md:164, script default `720`), `MERGE_LEASE_REF_PREFIX` (README.md:172, default `refs/merge-lease/`) and `MERGE_LEASE_METRICS_ENABLED` (README.md:169, which says "not wired as a repo variable", default `true`). How should the new env lines and the contract test treat them?
Choices:
- A) Apply the issue's own `MAX_HOLD_MINUTES` rule to all three: a setting that no workflow passes today stays out of the required set and out of the env blocks. The test requires the 8 settings that are already wired (`ENABLED`, `TTL_MINUTES`, `WAIT_LABEL`, `REVOKE_ENABLED`, `IDLE_MINUTES`, `PRIORITY_HEAD_PREFIXES`, `SOFT_PATHS`, `MAX_HOLDERS`) and keeps a short list of the unwired names, so a block that passes one of them fails the test. (RECOMMENDED)
- B) Newly expose `MERGE_LEASE_REF_PREFIX` and `MERGE_LEASE_METRICS_ENABLED` as repo variables in every lease step, written as `${{ vars.X || '<script default>' }}`, and update their README rows. `MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLD_MINUTES` stays unwired, as the issue says. The test requires 10 settings.
- C) Newly expose all three, `MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLD_MINUTES` included (default `'720'`), in every lease step, with README updates. The test requires all 11.
